pmkisan.name: PM-KISAN
pmkisan.benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three installments of Rs 2,000 every four months

base_requirements.reason: Only landholding farmer families are covered; farmers who do not own land are not eligible

exclusions.reason: Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded
Registered, practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects are excluded
Serving or retired government officers and employees are excluded (except MTS, Class IV, Group D)
Retired pensioners with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more are excluded (except MTS, Class IV, Group D)
Former or present holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors and district panchayat chairpersons are excluded
Non-resident Indian landholding families are excluded

assumptions: Professional, government-employee, pension, constitutional-post, NRI and institutional-landholder exclusions are not asked in chat; the answer lists them as conditions

pmjay.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
pmjay.benefit: Rs 5 lakh per family per year, cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

routes.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (age 70 or above, any income)

all_of.reason: All citizens aged 70 and above are eligible irrespective of income
Families listed in SECC 2011 deprivation or occupational categories are eligible

assumptions: SECC listing cannot be known from the chat; the bot should tell the user to check on the official PM-JAY portal

vahli_dikri.name: Vahli Dikri Yojana
vahli_dikri.benefit: Rs 4,000 at Class 1, Rs 6,000 at Class 9, Rs 1,00,000 after Class 12 higher education or marriage

base_requirements.reason: Family annual income must be below Rs 2 lakh
Benefit is given to only two live girl children per family
Girl child must be born after 02-08-2019

assumptions: Source says income 'less than Rs 2 lakh'; the checker uses <= 200000 and the bot should say 'up to Rs 2 lakh' only if the official page does

ma_yojana.name: Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA) Yojana
ma_yojana.benefit: Rs 5 lakh per family per year, cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

routes.name: BPL family in state BPL list (MA Yojana)

all_of.reason: Families in the state BPL list are eligible

routes.name: Income up to Rs 4 lakh (MA Vatsalya)

all_of.reason: Families marginally above poverty line with income up to Rs 4,00,000

routes.name: Senior citizen, family income up to Rs 6 lakh (MA Vatsalya)

all_of.reason: Total family annual income up to Rs 6,00,000

routes.name: Class-3 or Class-4 fixed pay state employee

all_of.reason: Class-3 and Class-4 employees on fixed payroll of the state government are covered

assumptions: Source says 'senior citizens' without an age; 60 is the standard Indian definition, verify on the official page
4 lakh and 6 lakh routes are officially MA Vatsalya Yojana criteria; MA Yojana itself covers the state BPL list
